jobs.title: Head of Platform (Infrastructure & DevOps)
jobs.description:
What we are building

Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.

Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Our team

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Your mission

Mimica is growing fast, and so is the demand on our Platform Team. As Head of Platform, you will lead a lean but highly capable team that is the backbone of every engineering squad in the company, and you will own the infrastructure strategy, including all AI infrastructure, as we scale.

The Platform team services the entire engineering organisation: keeping environments healthy, unblocking teams, building the infrastructure that lets everyone else move faster, and working with teams regarding SRE topics and developer experience too. As you work with us, the role will develop into designing Mimica’s infrastructure strategy at scale. The team has 4 engineers today, around 6 by the end of the year, and 10+ in 2027, so the role has the potential to grow into a “manager of managers” level as the company grows.

This is a role with real scope: expanding to multi-region and physically separated database environments, supporting Mimica’s first installable infrastructure component for enterprise, and owning FinOps. One day you are defining the standard menu of deployment options for enterprise customers, the next you are in a security review or an architecture decision on AI infrastructure.

We are looking for leaders with either an application development or a systems/infrastructure background.

What matters more than your origin story is your hands-on credibility with Kubernetes, IaC, and cloud platforms, your ability to lead engineers and other leaders, and your ability to collaborate closely with Product, ML, Security, Sales and Customer Success. If you want to work in a place where your contributions are visible, your scope is broad, and the problems are real, this is the role for you.

Part of your day-to-day

Own Mimica's infrastructure strategy and the platform roadmap across all products, with the final call on cloud architecture, deployment models, infra vendors and platform standards.
Lead and grow the Platform team: Manage existing Platform and SREs, plan headcount, set goals and metrics, and design the sub-team split (Cloud & Developer Platform, Reliability & SRE, AI Infrastructure) as the team grows.
Own all AI infrastructure, including training and serving infra, MLOps tooling, Vertex and model access.
Maintain Mimica’s DevEx culture - improve agency for product teams without compromising on compliance, create paved roads for deployments, and identify pain points as they arise.
Own the infra and LLM budget, forecast and unit economics, including cost attribution by product and customer and the GCP relationship.
Own reliability across engineering: SLOs, on-call model, incident process, postmortems, DR testing and capacity planning.
Own the CI/CD and developer platform, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, ArgoCD, Crossplane) and observability standards (Honeycomb, Grafana, Loki).
Work with the Platform PM, your peer, to define client needs and turn them into the platform roadmap.
Act as the named technical owner for infrastructure in enterprise deals and security reviews, joining high-stakes sales and client calls and coaching your team to take the rest.
Guide the craft mentors for infrastructure, MLOps and Python engineering, and set engineering-wide standards for reliability, on-call, CI/CD and craft.
Report monthly platform health and costs to leadership, and lead the infrastructure part of technical due diligence.

Requirements

Proven experience leading engineers, ideally including managing a team lead or other managers, and growing a team through hiring and sub-team design.
Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes, whether on GKE (preferred), EKS, OnPrem, or another managed Kubernetes service, across multiple regions.
Proven experience with infrastructure-as-code as a core part of your platform, such as Terraform, and with ArgoCD or a comparable GitOps tool.
A track record in owning reliability: setting SLOs and SLAs, running on-call, leading incident response and postmortems, and testing disaster recovery.
Observability experience with at least one major platform: Honeycomb, Datadog, Grafana, or New Relic.
Comfortable with code, and able to review architecture and prototypes hands-on.
Experience owning an infrastructure budget, including cloud cost attribution, forecasting and cloud-provider relationships.
Experience designing deployment models for enterprise customers (single tenant, regional, data residency) and supporting security reviews and contracted SLAs.
Background in startups or scale-ups: you are used to ambiguity, moving fast, and wearing multiple hats.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: you can translate infrastructure complexity into clear language for engineers, executives and clients, and you know when to say no to bespoke requests.

Bonus / Nice to have

Familiarity with Crossplane, or a similar product like Config Connector.
Experience with Temporal for workflow orchestration.
Security and compliance experience, particularly supporting SOC 2.
Experience supporting a funding round, including technical due diligence.

What we offer

💰 Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills.

🏢 Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix.

💻 Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget

📍 Flexible schedules and location

☀️ Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays

🍼 Enhanced parental leave

🧘‍♀️ Health & retirement benefits

📖 Annual learning & development budget

🌴 Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials

🌍 Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work

Note
: Some benefits may vary depending on location and role

⚠️ Mimica will only contact candidates from an @mimica.ai email address. We do not request banking or sensitive personal information during the recruiting process.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering, Platform/Services
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Engineering, Platform/Services based in the Canada .

The Director of Engineering will lead teams responsible for building and operating critical platforms that support millions of users worldwide. This remote leadership role combines technical strategy, organizational development, and hands-on architectural judgment to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable services. You will oversee core platform capabilities, including location and messaging services, cloud infrastructure, identity systems, and partner integrations. Working closely with Product, Security, Data, and Engineering leaders, you will align technology investments with business priorities and accelerate product innovation. You will anticipate scaling challenges, modernize existing systems, and establish high standards for reliability, performance, and cost efficiency. This is an opportunity to develop strong engineering leaders, foster accountability, and shape the technical foundations of a rapidly growing digital platform.

Accountabilities

Lead engineering teams responsible for critical platform services, including location and messaging, cloud infrastructure, identity management, and partner ecosystems, ensuring systems can reliably support hundreds of millions of members.
Define technical direction and long-term platform strategy, anticipating architectural bottlenecks, reliability risks, and scalability challenges before they affect users.
Modernize legacy systems thoughtfully, balancing immediate business priorities with long-term investments in performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.
Establish and maintain high engineering standards for service availability, observability, incident response, security, and system resilience.
Build a culture of ownership and accountability in which teams proactively identify problems, make informed decisions, and continuously improve engineering quality.
Develop meaningful engineering metrics covering reliability, performance, infrastructure costs, security, and developer productivity, using data to guide investment decisions and communicate business impact.
Recruit, coach, and develop engineering managers, staff engineers, and technical leaders, empowering them to lead teams and deliver outcomes independently.
Build reusable services, APIs, and shared platforms that reduce duplication, improve developer productivity, and enable product teams to deliver features more quickly.
Expand partner capabilities through secure, scalable integrations that make it easier for external partners to build on the platform.
Connect engineering investments to measurable business outcomes, making informed trade-offs among reliability, scalability, cost, and delivery speed.
Collaborate with Product, Security, Data, and other Engineering leaders to align priorities, resolve ownership and resource conflicts, and translate business strategy into actionable roadmaps.
Represent engineering needs and technical risks to senior leadership, supporting strategic planning and cross-functional decision-making.
Remain engaged in architectural reviews and critical technical decisions while encouraging pragmatic problem-solving and sound engineering judgment.
Champion AI-assisted development, automation, and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency.

Requirements

At least 10 years of software engineering experience, including 5 or more years leading engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience managing engineering managers and developing leaders who can independently guide teams and make sound technical decisions.
A strong track record of leading backend or platform engineering for large-scale distributed systems serving millions of users, with B2B or B2C platform experience considered relevant.
Experience leading platform engineering initiatives across cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and business-critical services; AWS experience is preferred.
Proven ability to translate company strategy into technical roadmaps and communicate engineering priorities, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership.
Experience modernizing legacy systems while balancing existing operational needs with long-term architectural improvements.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, including the ability to resolve ownership disagreements, competing priorities, and complex stakeholder challenges.
Excellent technical judgment and the ability to balance reliability, performance, scalability, security, cost, and delivery speed.
Demonstrated ability to build accountable, high-performing engineering teams and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions and their business implications.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits

Salary for US-based candidates: $216,500–$318,500 USD, with final compensation determined by experience, skills, job-related knowledge, and geographic location.
Equity compensation: Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) included as part of total compensation.
Healthcare coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with premiums fully paid for US employees.
Insurance protection: Life and disability insurance coverage.
Retirement savings: 401(k) plan with company matching.
Paid parental leave: Support for employees welcoming a new child.
Flexible time off: Flexible paid time off, companywide holidays, and scheduled summer and winter shutdowns.
Mental wellness support: Mental Wellness Program and Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
Professional development: Learning and development programs to support continued growth.
Remote work support: Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support to help employees maintain a productive remote working environment.
Membership perks: Complimentary premium membership and tracking devices.
Remote-first culture: A primarily remote working environment for eligible employees in the United States and Canada.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Our team

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. Your mission

Mimica is growing fast, and so is the demand on our Platform Team. As Head of Platform, you will lead a lean but highly capable team that is the backbone of every engineering squad in the company, and you will own the infrastructure strategy, including all AI infrastructure, as we scale.

The Platform team services the entire engineering organisation: keeping environments healthy, unblocking teams, building the infrastructure that lets everyone else move faster, and working with teams regarding SRE topics and developer experience too. As you work with us, the role will develop into designing Mimica’s infrastructure strategy at scale. The team has 4 engineers today, around 6 by the end of the year, and 10+ in 2027, so the role has the potential to grow into a “manager of managers” level as the company grows.

This is a role with real scope: expanding to multi-region and physically separated database environments, supporting Mimica’s first installable infrastructure component for enterprise, and owning FinOps. One day you are defining the standard menu of deployment options for enterprise customers, the next you are in a security review or an architecture decision on AI infrastructure.

We are looking for leaders with either an application development or a systems/infrastructure background.

What matters more than your origin story is your hands-on credibility with Kubernetes, IaC, and cloud platforms, your ability to lead engineers and other leaders, and your ability to collaborate closely with Product, ML, Security, Sales and Customer Success. If you want to work in a place where your contributions are visible, your scope is broad, and the problems are real, this is the role for you.

Part of your day-to-day

Own Mimica's infrastructure strategy and the platform roadmap across all products, with the final call on cloud architecture, deployment models, infra vendors and platform standards.
Lead and grow the Platform team: Manage existing Platform and SREs, plan headcount, set goals and metrics, and design the sub-team split (Cloud & Developer Platform, Reliability & SRE, AI Infrastructure) as the team grows.
Own all AI infrastructure, including training and serving infra, MLOps tooling, Vertex and model access.
Maintain Mimica’s DevEx culture - improve agency for product teams without compromising on compliance, create paved roads for deployments, and identify pain points as they arise.
Own the infra and LLM budget, forecast and unit economics, including cost attribution by product and customer and the GCP relationship.
Own reliability across engineering: SLOs, on-call model, incident process, postmortems, DR testing and capacity planning.
Own the CI/CD and developer platform, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, ArgoCD, Crossplane) and observability standards (Honeycomb, Grafana, Loki).
Work with the Platform PM, your peer, to define client needs and turn them into the platform roadmap.
Act as the named technical owner for infrastructure in enterprise deals and security reviews, joining high-stakes sales and client calls and coaching your team to take the rest.
Guide the craft mentors for infrastructure, MLOps and Python engineering, and set engineering-wide standards for reliability, on-call, CI/CD and craft.
Report monthly platform health and costs to leadership, and lead the infrastructure part of technical due diligence.

Requirements

Proven experience leading engineers, ideally including managing a team lead or other managers, and growing a team through hiring and sub-team design.
Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes, whether on GKE (preferred), EKS, OnPrem, or another managed Kubernetes service, across multiple regions.
Proven experience with infrastructure-as-code as a core part of your platform, such as Terraform, and with ArgoCD or a comparable GitOps tool.
A track record in owning reliability: setting SLOs and SLAs, running on-call, leading incident response and postmortems, and testing disaster recovery.
Observability experience with at least one major platform: Honeycomb, Datadog, Grafana, or New Relic.
Comfortable with code, and able to review architecture and prototypes hands-on.
Experience owning an infrastructure budget, including cloud cost attribution, forecasting and cloud-provider relationships.
Experience designing deployment models for enterprise customers (single tenant, regional, data residency) and supporting security reviews and contracted SLAs.
Background in startups or scale-ups: you are used to ambiguity, moving fast, and wearing multiple hats.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: you can translate infrastructure complexity into clear language for engineers, executives and clients, and you know when to say no to bespoke requests.

Bonus / Nice to have

Familiarity with Crossplane, or a similar product like Config Connector.
Experience with Temporal for workflow orchestration.
Security and compliance experience, particularly supporting SOC 2.
Experience supporting a funding round, including technical due diligence.
